newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500s end down sharply, off lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500s end down sharply, off lows.

text.p: March 27 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures ended sharply lower but off the day's lows. Traders note a frenzy of panic selling that shoved June to match the Jan 13 low. Huge sellstops at 788.00 and 782.55. Traders noted large pockets of illiquidity in the market that exacerbated losses. Fundamental woes tied to rate rise fears and weak bonds. No trade Friday.
